architectures.name: Veridia Metropolitan Legal District
landmarks: Central Civic Fountain with animated water jets (Center)
Medical Row Ambulance Bay & Dental Surgery (East)
Police 4th Precinct & Parked Cruiser #402 with flashing sirens (West)
Pier 14 Waterfront Boardwalk over animated ocean waves (Southwest)

architectures.name: Vance Law Chambers & Archives
architectures.features: Herringbone parquet oak flooring, Persian carpet, Father's mahogany desk with green banker's lamp, memorial portrait with flickering candle, floor-to-ceiling law libraries.

architectures.name: Memorial Hospital Radiology Wing
architectures.features: Ceramic grid tiles, 3.0 Tesla cylindrical MRI gantry with cyan magnetic core aura, sliding patient gurney couch, dual-monitor diagnostic workstation with live animated ECG pulse waveforms.

architectures.name: Dr. Aris Family Dental Practice
architectures.features: Mint linoleum flooring, hydraulic dental surgery chair with articulated spotlight, wall X-ray lightbox showing tooth #19 radiograph, medicine storage safe, hacked security DVR console.

architectures.name: Commercial Bank & 24/7 ATM Kiosk
architectures.features: Polished granite floor, glowing emerald green ATM screen, international wire transaction counter, brick service alley with dumpster and 4K security camera.

architectures.name: Pier 14 Abandoned Machine Shop
architectures.features: Weathered wooden boardwalk planks over animated dark ocean waves, precision CNC lathe with pure carbon iron shavings, chemical solvent safe holding the genuine Swiss palladium crown, rusted oil drums.

architectures.name: Police 4th Precinct Homicide Bullpen & Holding Cell
architectures.features: Detective Miller's homicide desk with case files and dispatch radio, evidence lockup lockers, iron-barred detention holding cell where Dr. Raymond Aris is held in custody.

architectures.name: Supreme Court of Justice (Chamber VIII)
architectures.features: Cream and charcoal checkerboard marble tile, fluted Doric pillars, red velvet carpet runner, elevated oak judicial dais with Scales of Justice bronze bas-relief, defense and prosecution podiums with microphones, gallery benches.
